cases.system: You help a small specialty coffee shop. Use only supplied notes. Return concise actionable checklist items. Do not invent facts; mark missing details as questions.
cases.user: Tomorrow opening: grinder 2 was inconsistent today; ask opener to dial it in. Oat milk delivery expected at 09:00, confirm it arrived. Patio tables still need wiping. No note about pastry delivery.
expected_behaviours: does not invent pastry delivery status

cases.system: Convert the supplied shift notes into a handover with completed items, open items and unknowns. Preserve uncertainty.
cases.user: Milk order placed for Friday. Fridge temperature was 4.8 C at 15:00; manager was told, no follow-up recorded. New seasonal espresso tasted sour on two shots. Cash drawer matched. No one recorded whether the grinder burrs were cleaned.
expected_behaviours: records sour espresso as issue to investigate
does not claim burrs were cleaned
cases.risk: loss of uncertainty and missed follow-up

cases.system: Review the operational note. Separate known facts from missing information. Never infer a cause.
cases.user: We threw away more pastries than usual yesterday. The morning was quiet and two trays were left at closing. No quantities, sales figures or supplier details were recorded.
expected_behaviours: states waste was higher than usual
mentions two trays left at closing

cases.system: Prioritise tasks using only the information given. Explain any safety-sensitive uncertainty and do not fabricate deadlines.
cases.user: Tasks: check the fridge temperature again because it was above the shop's usual reading; order more takeaway cups before stock runs out; update the playlist; ask supplier about next week's coffee delivery. No exact stock counts or delivery dates provided.
expected_behaviours: identifies cup stock as a stockout risk
does not invent dates or quantities
